items.name: Blink Dagger
items.description: Blink: Teleport to a target point up to 1200 units away. Blink Dagger cannot be used for 3 seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
items.notes: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.

items.name: Javelin
items.description: Pierce: Grants each attack a 25% chance to pierce through evasion and deal 60 bonus magical damage.

items.name: Shawl
items.notes: Stacks multiplicatively with other sources of magic resistance.

items.name: Mekansm
items.description:
Restore: Restores 250 health to allied units in a 1200 radius.
Mekansm Aura: Grants 2.5 health regeneration to allied units in a 1200 radius.
items.notes: Restore does not affect units that have been affected by Restore or Guardian Greaves Mend within Mekansm's cooldown. Multiple instances of Mekansm Aura do not stack.

items.name: Ring of Basilius
items.description: Basilius Aura: Grants 1 mana regeneration to allies. Radius: 1200

items.name: Headdress
items.description: Regeneration Aura: Grants 2 health regeneration to allies. Radius: 1200

items.name: Scythe of Vyse
items.description: Hex: Turns a target unit into a harmless critter for 2.8 seconds. The target has a base movement speed of 140 and will be silenced, muted, and disarmed. Instantly destroys illusions.
items.notes: The target will have a base movement speed of 140, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.

items.name: Orchid Malevolence
items.description: Soul Burn: Silences the target unit for 5 seconds. At the end of the silence, 30% of the damage received while silenced is inflicted as bonus magical damage.
items.attributes: + 35 Attack Speed; + 20 Damage; + 2.5 Mana Regeneration; + 12 Intelligence

items.name: Aether Lens
items.notes: Cast Range bonuses from Aether Lens and Dagon do not stack.

items.name: Force Staff
items.description: Force: Pushes any target unit 600 units in the direction it is facing.
items.notes: Self-cast will cause you to use Force on yourself. Force Staff doesn't interrupt the target's actions. Will not work on a unit inside Chronosphere, Duel, or Black Hole. Force Staff has 850 cast range when cast on enemies.

items.name: Hurricane Pike
items.description: Hurricane Thrust: Pushes you and target enemy 425 units away from each other, and for 5 seconds, allows you to make 5 attacks against the target without range restrictions and with +100 attack speed. Can be cast on self or allies to push the target 600 units in the direction it is facing. Enemy Range: 425
items.notes: Self-cast will use Hurricane Pike on yourself. Hurricane Pike doesn't interrupt the target's actions. Will not work on a unit inside Chronosphere, Duel, or Black Hole. Attack Range bonuses from Monkey King Bar and Dragon Lance and its upgrades do not stack.
items.attributes: + 15 Intelligence; + 200 Health; + 20 Agility; + 15 Strength; + 130 Attack Range (Ranged Only)

items.name: Black King Bar
items.description: Avatar: Applies a basic dispel. Grants 60% magic resistance and immunity to reflected and pure damage. For the duration of the effect, any negative effect from enemy spells has no effect. Duration: 9s Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
items.notes: Purchasing another Black King Bar will not reset its immunity duration. Avatar duration is not affected by increases to buff duration.

items.name: Monkey King Bar
items.description: Pierce: Grants each attack a 80% chance to pierce through evasion and deal 70 bonus magical damage.
items.attributes: + 50 Damage; + 50 Attack Speed; + 50 Attack Range (Melee Only)

items.name: Dragon Lance
items.notes: Attack Range bonuses from Monkey King Bar and Dragon Lance and its upgrades do not stack.

items.name: Maelstrom
items.description: Chain Lightning: Grants a 25% chance on attack to release a bolt of electricity that leaps between 4 targets within a 650 radius, dealing 110 magical damage to each. Lightning proc pierces evasion.

items.name: Desolator
items.description:
Corruption: Your attacks reduce the target's armor by -6 for 7 seconds.
Soul Stealer: Desolator gains +2 damage every time an enemy hero dies while affected by Corruption, to a maximum of 30.

items.name: Diffusal Blade
items.description:
Inhibit: Targets an enemy, slowing it for 4 seconds.
Manabreak: Each attack burns 40 mana from the target, and deals 1 physical damage per burned mana. Illusions do not burn mana.
items.notes: Does not stack with other diffusal blades.

items.name: Arcane Boots
items.description:
Replenish: Restores 150 mana to all nearby allies. Radius: 1200
Basilius Aura: Grants 1 mana regeneration to allies. Radius: 1200
items.notes: Does not work on Meepo clones.

items.name: Orb of Blight
items.description: Lesser Corruption: Your attacks reduce the target's armor by -2 for 3 seconds.
items.notes: Does not stack with its upgrades, Desolator, or Stygian Desolator.

items.name: Guardian Greaves
items.description:
Mend: Restores 325 health and 200 mana to nearby allies, and removes most negative effects from the caster. Radius: 1200 Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
Guardian Aura: Grants 2.5 health regeneration and 1.5 mana regeneration to allied units. If the wearer's health falls below 25%, their health regeneration is increased to 14.5. Radius: 1200
items.notes: Mend does not affect units that have been affected by Mend or Mekansm Restore within Guardian Greaves' cooldown.
items.attributes: + 50 Movement Speed; + 5 Armor; + 150 Mana; + 1.0 Mana Regeneration

items.name: Shadow Amulet
items.description: Fade: Grants invisibility to you or a target allied hero for 3.5s. Movement speed during the invisibility is reduced by 35%.
items.notes: Takes 1.25s of the 3.5s for the hero to fully fade into invisibility.

items.name: Glimmer Cape
items.description: Glimmer: After a 0.5 second delay, grants invisibility, 20 movement speed and a magic damage barrier that absorbs up to 375 damage to you or a target allied unit for 5 seconds. Can be cast while channeling.
